# kion_account_linkage (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion AccountLinkage by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_account_linkage" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the AccountLinkage to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `azure_object_id` (String)
- `payer_id` (Number)
- `user_id` (Number)
